title: Bad Apple!!
description: Shadow-art music video for Alstroemeria Records' remix "Bad Apple!! feat. nomico". The original theme was composed by ZUN for stage 3 of Touhou Project 4: Lotus Land Story, released at Comiket 54 on 1998-08-14. Masayoshi Minoshima's vocal remix, sung by nomico, was released on the album Lovelight on 2007-05-20. Based on a storyboard published by Nico Nico Douga user Μμ on 2008-06-08, Anira (あにら) and a group of collaborators released the black-and-white silhouette PV as sm8628149 on Nico Nico Douga on 2009-10-27 (JST); it was reuploaded to YouTube the same day. It became the first Nico Nico video to reach 10 million views (October 2010) and Alstroemeria Records recognised Anira's animation as the official music video on 2020-05-21. The first YouTube link is the original 3:39 PV. The other two are fan versions covering the full song: luigiman09's 2011 montage with Romaji/English lyrics, and ElectricTheAnimations162's 2023 recreation of the full-length PV, made with several other animators. The original full-length PV is still lost media: it was never officially released online and only partial recordings from live events survive. It was first shown at Animelo Summer Live 2010, where nomico sang the full "Bad Apple!! feat. nomico" while the extended shadow-art video played on the screen behind her; it was also shown at Nico Nico Dai Kaigi 2010-2011 FINAL and Nico Nico Cho Party II. The extended version includes scenes that are not in Anira's 3:39 PV, probably based on Μμ's full storyboard, and the extra scenes were made by another artist with permission.
